# Agent Brain

> Write a note once. Claude, Cursor and every chat answer from it, and show the source.

Agent Brain is a shared memory for a team. Notes live in your own git repo as plain markdown. Every chat answers from those notes and shows the source file. Edit a note once and every agent uses the new version.

The Free plan is $0: your notes, any agent, a source on every answer, and your git repo. The Team plan is USD 10/month: shared memory, and a record of who changed what.

## Links

- [Agent Brain](https://brain.mcpbox.dev/): product home
- [Computer](https://computer.mcpbox.dev): a computer your AI can use
